newsitem.title: USA: RailTex says June carloadings up 33 pct.
newsitem.headline: RailTex says June carloadings up 33 pct.

text.p: RailTex Inc said Monday that June 1997 carloadings increased 33 percent to 39,898 from 29,944 in June 1996.
The company said it experienced traffic gains in autos, coal, chemicals, paper, metals and other products.
On a "same railroad" basis, carloadings increased 6 percent to 30,602 in June 1997 from 28,818 in June 1996.
The company said it experienced "same railroad" traffic gains in coal, paper and chemicals but these gains were partially offset by decreased traffic levels for farm products and metals.
Year-to-date June 1997 carloadings increased 32 percent to 231,940 from 176,134 in the prior year period, the company said.
"Same railroad" carloadings increased 2 percent to 177,776 from 173,852 in the prior year period, the company said.
